title: quality_audit queue counts repo-wide sweeps (relicense, CodeQL bulk fix) as changes, so every row says 'changed since audit'
problem: changes_since() counted every commit under a subject. The 2026-11-25 relicense (3e316e115) and CodeQL backlog fix (1070ed690) touched 1,450 and 439 two-level directories, so every queued row read 'changed since audit' and the note no longer singled out rows a commit may have fixed.
evidence: python3 platform/ci/quality_audit.py queue --limit 200 --no-prs --seed 2026-11-25-029a on main, 2026-11-25: 200 of 200 rows 'changed since audit', most naming only the relicense or the CodeQL fix
git diff-tree --name-only -r 3e316e115: 7,921 files in 1,450 directories; 1070ed690: 864 files in 439
change: Treat a commit touching SWEEP_DIRS (25) or more distinct two-level directories as a sweep: excluded from 'changed', shown as '(+N repo-wide, ignored)'.
metric: Rows saying 'changed since audit' among the first 200 of quality_audit.py queue --no-prs --seed 2026-11-25-029a
source: prompts/runs doc_friction on platform/ci/quality_audit.py (2026-11-25) and this run's re-check
result: helped: 200 of 200 -> 68 of 200 rows changed on the same seed and limit (this PR, 2026-11-25)
